What had happened between father and daughter?

en.html:
It did not sound like evasion.
She truly did not have the answer. Nor, from her expression, was she looking for it.

Perhaps she still could not face that past. Look back, and the answer would be there. She knew that. That was precisely why looking back was impossible.

A nail into a wound that had never healed.

Had our conversation done some good, then? Was that why she had let me see this much of the wound?
I could only wonder.

Curiosity was no reason to keep digging.
Besides, what she had said already told me something.

en.html:
Yes.
This girl and I were the same.

The parent she had loved and respected above anyone else—she had killed him. After that, no way back.

Killing a parent had put a curse on her life.

...Now I understood where this distortion came from. Her insistence on justice.

If her father's blood had opened that road, how could she deny it? How could she turn back? That would make a sacrifice so heavy, so precious, worth nothing.

The same as me.

Fate. I did not like that word. Too much escape in it.
But perhaps the meeting between Ichijou and me deserved exactly that name.

A father-killer meeting a mother-killer.

...If this really was fate, where would it carry us in the end?

en.html:
Her voice grew quieter, then hoarse. Finally it disappeared into the sound of her sleeping breath.

—Was that right?

The question she had left, I kept turning over. Breaking it down inside my head, examining it carefully.

Was that right?
...Was it?

Hate evil. Hold up justice and punish it.
That should not be wrong.
Should be right.

Justice. From this girl, of all people, I could believe the word. No private interest entered her judgment of good and evil. The strictness of it was almost frightening.

Even killing Doushin Yusa—the inconvenience was political. If the question was right or wrong, then Ichijou's rightness was clear.

So I thought.

But.
Really.
Was that right?

...No answer. However much I thought, no answer would come.

ja.html:
一条の声は次第に小さく、やがてかすれて。
　最後は寝息の中に溶けて消えた。

　――<ruby>それ<rt>・・</rt></ruby>でいいのか。

　溶けた問いかけを反芻する。
　脳漿の中で噛み砕き、慎重に吟味する。

　それでいいのか。
　
　……いいのか？

　悪を憎み。
　正義を掲げてそれを罰する。

　それは――間違ってはいない筈だ。
　正しい――筈だ。

　正義。
　他ならぬこの少女が語るなら信じられる。

　彼女は善悪の判断において全く無私だ。
　厳正極まる裁きを下す。空恐ろしい程に。

　遊佐童心の殺害とて。
　不都合があるとすればそれはただ政略的にであって、
理非を問うなら一条の正しさは明らかだ。

　そう思う。
　
　だが。

　本当に。
　<ruby>それでいいのか<rt>・・・・・・・</rt></ruby>？

　……答えは出ない。
　いくら考えても、俺はその答えを出せなかった。
